WITH RECURSIVE LeafNodes AS ( -- 识别末级节点 SELECT id, name, code, level, parent_id FROM ins_channel WHERE id NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT parent_id FROM ins_channel WHERE parent_id IS NOT NULL ) ), PathCTE AS ( -- 从末级节点开始向上递归 SELECT ln.id AS leaf_id, ln.name AS leaf_name, ln.code AS leaf_code, ic.id, ic.parent_id, ic.name, ic.code, ic.level, 1 AS path_order FROM LeafNodes ln JOIN ins_channel ic ON ln.id = ic.id
UNION ALL
SELECT pc.leaf_id, pc.leaf_name, pc.leaf_code, ic.id, ic.parent_id, ic.name, ic.code, ic.level, pc.path_order + 1 FROM PathCTE pc JOIN ins_channel ic ON ic.id = pc.parent_id WHERE ic.parent_id IS NOT NULL ) SELECT leaf_name, leaf_code, -- 按层级聚合 GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN level = 1 THEN name END) AS channelLevelOneName, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN level = 1 THEN code END) AS channelLevelOneCode, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN level = 2 THEN name END) AS channelLevelTwoName, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN level = 2 THEN code END) AS channelLevelTwoCode, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN level = 3 THEN name END) AS channelLevelThreeName, GROUP_CONCAT(CASE WHEN level = 3 THEN code END) AS channelLevelThreeCode, -- 完整路径 GROUP_CONCAT(name ORDER BY level SEPARATOR ' > ') AS full_hierarchy, GROUP_CONCAT(code ORDER BY level SEPARATOR ' > ') AS full_code_hierarchy, -- 路径深度 COUNT(*) AS path_depth FROM PathCTE GROUP BY leaf_id, leaf_name, leaf_code ORDER BY leaf_name
